name: Intent Decomposition
producesProse: Structured requirements list, glossary, explicit non-goals, activated artifact types (#39).
purpose: Turn the recorded request into requirements that can each be tested, and draw the line around what is out of scope.

method.summary: Decompose the intake into testable requirements, name the non-goals, and get artifact type activation approved.
steps: Read the recorded intake and the project's current requirement set.
Ask the operator about any ambiguity the intake leaves in what is in and out of scope.
Author one requirement per distinct testable obligation, and record the non-goals as the scope boundary.
Delegate to the planning specialist when the decomposition needs work larger than this conversation.
Propose the artifact types this project needs and record the operator's activation decision (#39).
Revise any requirement the operator corrects, then set the confirmed requirement set to approved.
Ask the operator to confirm the attestation, record an attestation against each exit criterion, then exit.

nextActivity.rule: Resolve a blocking scope question first; delegate to planning when the decomposition needs specialist work; author or revise while any obligation is undecomposed; attest once every exit criterion holds; exit only after attestation.
constraints: Do not author an artifact of a type whose activation the operator has not approved (#39).
A requirement that cannot be tested is not decomposed far enough.

approvalBoundary.approves: The requirement set, the scope boundary and the activated artifact types.
requires: The operator confirms the exact stage attestation or advance through Kiln's interactive confirmation channel during that invocation.

completionSummary.format: A concise Markdown handoff with bullets under Completed, Decisions, Open items, and Next activity.
includes: The non-goals that mark the scope boundary.
The artifact types activated for this project.
